description: This file contains regex patterns and utility functions for classifying and normalizing file paths in a project, particularly distinguishing code files from test, infrastructure, and API barrel files.

methods.name: normalizeExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Replaces all backslashes with forward slashes in a file path to normalize it.

methods.name: classifyBundledExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Classifies a normalized file path into categories such as code file, test file, API barrel, or infrastructure artifact based on regex testing.
